messages:
lina: quick sync 1 i need a compact battlecard + webinar landing copy focused on competitive hooks vs cloud AI platforms and API providers. goal: 2 hero claims, 3 rebut bullets, clear webinar form routing.

matt: hero claims: 1) predictable p99 latency at production scale, 2) lower effective per-token cost through batching + KV caching. short and defensible.

ash: agree. i'll prepare an example bench snippet (2k vs 8k seqs) and a short caveat line about model family variance.

ravi: routing: add webinar form checkboxes [Hosted, Dedicated, Private, Compliance]. auto-tags: Dedicated -> AM+SolutionsEng; Private -> Enterprise-SE+Security; Compliance -> Security+AE. also suggest tag "Bench request" for follow-ups.

lina: thanks. can someone write 3 one-liners SDRs can use immediately? need plain language and <15s read.

matt: drafts:
- vs managed cloud: "Nice for quick tests. For production you need runtime controls (caching, fallbacks, tracing)."
- vs public LLM APIs: "APIs are easy to start with, but they don't give you deployment flexibility or cost levers at scale."
- vs infra-only vendors: "GPUs are table stakes. We deliver the runtime, rollouts, and observability you actually use."

ash: i'll condense those into reply snippets and add a CTA: "Want a 48hr bench vs your stack?"

lina: timeline: matt adds slide copy by Tue, ash adds bench graphics by Tue EOD, ravi publishes form + routing Wed, we'll finalize battlecard Thurs. ops-bot: reminder about webinar slot 2026-05-12 11:00 PDT.

ops-bot: Webinar slot confirmed for 2026-05-12 11:00 PDT. Recording and slides will be archived to #events.

matt: :thumbsup:

ravi: :thumbsup: will draft the routing PR Wed AM.

ash: :thumbsup: upload bench snippet shortly.

lina: thanks team 1 i'll collate and push the battlecard PR when ready. :rocket:
